meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browser automation via Chrome/Chromium CDP — open, snapshot, click, screenshot. For testing web apps, mobile layouts, and automated interactions without Playwright/Puppeteer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动化完成网页测试与截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器做测试或截图
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser testing and screenshots via CDP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser for testing or screenshots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制 Chrome 浏览器打开网页、截图、点击元素、获取页面快照，用于测试网页或自动化操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 打开某个网址、截图、点击页面元素，或进行网页测试时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 点击页面上 id 为 submit 的按钮
say.note: Claude 会模拟点击该按钮。

say.text: 用 iPhone 14 模式打开我的网站
say.note: Claude 会模拟移动设备浏览。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control Chrome/Chromium to open URLs, take screenshots, click elements, and capture page snapshots for web testing or automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to open a URL, take a screenshot, click an element, or perform web testing.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the button with id submit
say_en.note: Claude will simulate clicking that button.

say_en.text: Open my website in iPhone 14 mode
say_en.note: Claude will emulate a mobile device.
